description: dotnet new template that scaffolds a complete UmbraCRM solution: shell, Core, TestSite, Contacts and Golf reference modules, and tests. SQLite is the default first-run experience; --DatabaseProvider SqlServer emits a LocalDB-style integrated-auth dev connection string (production deployments override via env vars). Validated against .NET 10, SQLite + SQL Server 2025; see the package README for parameters and details.
releaseNotes:
1.0.0-preview.1 — first preview of the UmbraCRM solution template.

What's included:
- Provider abstraction (SQLite + SQL Server 2025), validated end-to-end.
- Two reference modules: Contacts (single-entity) and Golf (multi-entity + SignalR).
- AI search layer with hash-fallback and OpenAI providers; vector-store JSON storage available on both providers.
- Two pre-built appsettings.Development.json variants selectable via --DatabaseProvider Sqlite|SqlServer.
- Generated solutions ship with a README at the solution root, a committed Vite App_Plugins bundle (no Node.js required for first build), .gitignore, MIT LICENSE, and clean CI hygiene.
- 203 / 203 tests pass on a freshly-scaffolded default instance (143 Core + 21 Contacts + 39 Golf).
- Validated on a hosted GitHub Actions windows-latest runner via the platform's template-validation workflow.

Known limitations:
- Native vector indexes (sqlite-vec, SQL Server 2025 native vector type) are deferred to a later phase; v1 uses JSON-encoded embeddings + C# cosine similarity on both providers.
- Deferred parameters: --include-sample-modules, --IncludeCI, marketplace metadata conditional emission, <RepositoryUrl/> csproj injection, kebab-case flag aliases.
- 7 NU190x package-vulnerability warnings inherited from upstream Umbraco.Cms 17.0.0, MailKit 4.15.1, and System.Security.Cryptography.Xml 8.0.0; tracked for a follow-up preview increment.

See https://github.com/ManiPeralta/UmbraCRM for source, docs, and issue tracking.
title: UmbraCRM Solution Template
